facts.fact: StackAdapt's internal analysis states that click-based attribution models account for roughly 7% of StackAdapt interactions, leaving most influence unaccounted for.
facts.quote: Internal analysis shows that click-based models account for roughly 7% of StackAdapt interactions, leaving most influence unaccounted for.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that 41% of conversions happen without a paid click, per its Conversion 2026 announcement.
facts.quote: In fact, 41% of conversions happen without a paid click, meaning a large share of impact remains invisible in traditional reporting.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that programmatic campaigns are the first marketing touch point in 75% of conversion paths.
facts.quote: In 75% of conversion paths, it is the first marketing touch point, introducing users to a brand.

facts.fact: Based on StackAdapt platform data, a StackAdapt impression appears at the final stage before conversion in nearly half of conversions, even when it receives no credit.
facts.quote: Based on StackAdapt platform data, in nearly half of conversions, a StackAdapt impression appears at the final stage before conversion, even when it receives no credit.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's programmatic direct mail is introduced as a new in-platform channel for US marketers.
facts.quote: StackAdapt has also introduced programmatic direct mail as a new in-platform channel for US marketers, extending digital campaigns into the physical world.
